title: ID0414675-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P0 312567479/18] Black Screen
description:
problem description :
The terminal is at fault. The screen is black. The meters are off.
The connectors of the screen have been removed and reconnected,
The screen remained black.
Remote and local reboots did not solve the problem.
When you press the FC14, it turns off. When you press
new top, it lights up red again.
The regional team is familiar with the problem.
